name: Digitraffic Road (Finnish traffic measurement stations)
short: Vehicle counts and average speeds over 5-minute windows at Finnish road stations; free, keyless JSON.
summary: Fintraffic's Digitraffic service publishes traffic measurement station (TMS) data for Finnish roads: vehicle counts and mean speeds over 5-minute windows, per direction. All stations come in one call. No key is needed.

tasks: current vehicle speed on a Finnish road

pricing.notes: Terms of service page: open data under CC 4.0 BY. No fee or key is mentioned.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: the all-stations call listed 522 stations; some had empty sensor lists with an epoch timestamp.

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: the all-stations call listed 522 stations; some had empty sensor lists with an epoch timestamp.

coverage.notes: Stations along the Finnish road network; some stations return no values.

licensing.summary: Digitraffic terms: Fintraffic's open data is licensed under Creative Commons 4.0 BY, which allows distributing, remixing and commercial use with credit to the source; the notice and a link to the licence must be kept and changes indicated. AI training and resale are not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Latest sensor values for all stations; 5-minute counts and speeds.

api.notes: Requests need an Accept-Encoding: gzip header; without it the server answers 406. Sensor names are Finnish codes such as KESKINOPEUS_5MIN_LIUKUVA_SUUNTA1 (mean speed, direction 1).

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each sensor value has a measured time from the station; how the clock is kept is not stated.

location.unknown: Station coordinates are published; nothing proves a station has not been moved.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.

sources.claim: Digitraffic terms of service: CC 4.0 BY licence and attribution rules
